{"category_edits":[{"category":"learning_objective","rationale":"Replace batch-wide negative-score weighting with candidate-set cross-entropy at each valid sequence position. Each candidate set contains the positive and its existing sampled negative; average uniformly over valid positions. Preserve sampling, GRU architecture, inference, optimizer and training settings for all four category models.","edits":[{"find":"    valid_pos = pos_scores[mask]
    valid_neg = neg_scores[mask]
    weights = torch.softmax(valid_neg.detach(), dim=0)
    pairwise_loss = torch.nn.functional.softplus(valid_neg - valid_pos)
    return (weights * pairwise_loss).sum()","replace":"    valid_pos = pos_scores[mask].float()
    valid_neg = neg_scores[mask].float()
    candidate_logits = torch.stack((valid_pos, valid_neg), dim=-1)
    return (torch.logsumexp(candidate_logits, dim=-1) - valid_pos).mean()"}]}],"change_summary":"Use uniformly averaged candidate-set cross-entropy with the existing sampled negative and valid-position mask. No predictor changes are required."}
